frontend.name: RetroArch
frontend.historySemantics: Normal-forward N=1: Original is the current core image, OriginalHistory1/2 are the preceding source images, and PassFeedback0 is the preceding response-pass output; causal wrap and frame-parity probes passed on this target.
frontend.frameDuplication: No explicit duplication mode was exposed; normal fixed-vsync execution presented one shader update per core video callback.
frontend.variableRefresh: Unavailable on the tested target; only fixed 60 Hz was exposed.

checks.observation: Quick Menu Restart returned to the title boot sequence; the feedback pass reinitialized and continued without a shader, Vulkan, or process failure.
Restarting RetroArch reloaded the same content and formal target override; the temporal shader compiled and resumed near 60 fps.

A state saved in a castle scene was loaded after returning to the title; emulated content rewound while panel feedback remained causal, producing a transient optical transition and then settling without failure.
Quick Menu pause/resume preserved the shader and resumed normally. Long wall-clock decay during pause is not modeled because the shader clock stops with presentation.
Disabled in the effective GBA core/content override because shader feedback cannot reconstruct physical history while emulator time moves backward.
Disabled in the effective GBA core/content override because speculative/discarded frontend frames are outside the normal-forward feedback contract.
A temporary 4x probe presented only about 47-49 fps, so emulated frames were not represented as real-time panel updates. The final GBA override fixes the ratio at 1.0.
No explicit frontend duplication mode was available to classify duplicate callbacks. Normal fixed-vsync execution remained near 60 fps; unknown duplicate timing requires the documented static bypass.
The KONKR target exposed only fixed 60 Hz, so variable-refresh integration was not exercised and remains unsupported by the fixed-period model.

notes: Verbose allocation logs confirmed pass 0 as R32G32B32A32_SFLOAT and pass 1 as R8G8B8A8_UNORM after removing the preset-level float_framebuffer0 override that had forced pass 0 to R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT. Unified diagnostic views 1-5, analytic/table GtG, 60x retention stress, and static/GtG/scan isolation presets compiled on-device. The temporary save state was preserved at RetroArch/states/.codex-validation/20260818/ws5-save-load.state. Global RetroArch configuration was restored; only GBA core/content safety overrides remain.
